items.title: The web is always talking: Link pings, Beacon, CSP
items.text: Image from Unsplash.com by Mostafa Moraji In the modern web ecosystem , pages are not just rendered — user interactions are tracked and analyzed to optimize user experience, and gather insights. When you click a link on a website, something else may happen besides navigation. When you close a tab, something might still be sent. Most users never see this traffic. Behind the scenes, the web is constantly talking. This is the privacy story of sendBeacon(), ping, CSP reports. sendBeacon() navigator.
